battleFormations.name: Host of Ascension
battleFormations.effect: A Perfect Ambush: Each time a Genestealer Cults unit is set up as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase its weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER].

battleFormations.name: Xenocreed Congregation
battleFormations.effect: Unquestioning Fanaticism: ACOLYTE HYBRIDS/HYBRID METAMORPHS/NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS units led by a Character re-roll Advance and Charge rolls; if that Character is a MAGUS, PRIMUS, or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, it also gains Feel No Pain 3+ while leading.

battleFormations.name: Biosanctic Broodsurge
battleFormations.effect: Hypermorphic Fury: +1 Charge roll for ABERRANTS/BIOPHAGUS/PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units; if they charged this turn, their melee weapons also get +1 Attacks that phase.

battleFormations.name: Outlander Claw
battleFormations.effect: Rapid Takeover: Non-Battle-shocked Genestealer Cults MOUNTED/VEHICLE models get +1 Objective Control. If an Atalan Jackals unit is near a controlled objective, it remains secured until your opponent's control level exceeds yours.

artefacts.name: Prowling Agitant
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS model only] If unengaged and an enemy ends a move within 8", the bearer's unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

artefacts.name: A Chink in Their Armour
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS model only] When set up as Reinforcements, until your next Fight phase the bearer's unit's ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

artefacts.name: Our Time Is Nigh
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS model only] Once per battle, when declaring a charge, add 2 to the Charge roll for the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Assassination Edict
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS model only] Attacks by the bearer's unit against Character units gain +1 to Hit.

artefacts.name: Gene-sire's Reliquant
artefacts.effect: [MAGUS/PRIMUS/ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only] Re-roll Battle-shock tests for the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Denunciator of Tyrants
artefacts.effect: [MAGUS/PRIMUS/ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only] Attacks by the bearer's unit against Character units gain +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

artefacts.name: Deeds That Speak to the Masses
artefacts.effect: [MAGUS/PRIMUS/ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only] Start the battle with 2 additional Resurgence points.

artefacts.name: Incendiary Inspiration
artefacts.effect: [MAGUS/PRIMUS/ACOLYTE ICONWARD model only] The bearer's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

artefacts.name: Predatory Instincts
artefacts.effect: [ABOMINANT/BIOPHAGUS/PATRIARCH model only] The bearer's unit gains Infiltrators; can be targeted with Heroic Intervention for -1CP regardless of prior uses that phase.

artefacts.name: Biomorph Adaptation
artefacts.effect: [ABOMINANT or PATRIARCH model only] +1 AP/Damage on the bearer's melee weapons.

artefacts.name: Mutagenic Regeneration
artefacts.effect: [ABOMINANT/BIOPHAGUS/PATRIARCH model only] Each Command phase, one model in the bearer's unit regains 1 lost wound.

artefacts.name: Alien Majesty
artefacts.effect: [ABOMINANT/BIOPHAGUS/PATRIARCH model only] Enemy units within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit have Objective Control reduced by 1 (min 1).

artefacts.name: Serpentine Tactics
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only] The bearer's unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

artefacts.name: Cartographic Data-leech
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS model only] While embarked, +1 Ballistic Skill to the Transport's Firing Deck attacks.

artefacts.name: Starfall Shells
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED model only] After shooting with a cult sniper rifle, hit units suffer -1 to Hit until your next Shooting phase.

artefacts.name: Assault Commando
artefacts.effect: [GENESTEALER CULTS model only] Re-roll Hit rolls for ranged attacks made after disembarking that turn.

armyRules.name: Cult Ambush
armyRules.effect: Start with Resurgence points by battle size (6/10/14). When a fully-eligible unit is destroyed, spend the listed Resurgence cost (based on Starting Strength) to add an identical replacement unit in Cult Ambush (a type of Strategic Reserves) and place a Cult Ambush marker more than 8" from all enemy units. Units set up via a Cult Ambush marker enter with one model in base contact and the rest within 3" of it; the marker is removed when an enemy model ends a move within 8" of it, or when used for an ingress move at the end of your opponent's next Movement phase.

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation. Removed 'Cult Ambush' from detachments list: it is the faction's always-on army rule, not a selectable Detachment.
